title: Finite local dimension for finite type schemes over a field
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field], $X$ a scheme [def-weil-scheme-over-base, def-pc-scheme] of finite type over $K$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and $x\in X$. Then the local ring $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ has finite Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring].

source.place: Lemma "lemma-dimension-at-a-point-finite-type-field" (Tag 00P1), together with the affine finite-type localization argument

proof.text: A field K is Noetherian, so Mathlib's spectrum instance gives IsLocallyNoetherian (Spec K). Apply LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian to the structure morphism to obtain IsLocallyNoetherian X. Only local Noetherianity is needed; quasi-compactness is not used.

Use Mathlib's Noetherian stalk instance for a locally Noetherian scheme. Its proof chooses an affine neighbourhood, identifies the stalk as localization at the corresponding prime, and applies IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing. The stalk is a local ring because X is a scheme.

The Mathlib instance FiniteRingKrullDim for Noetherian local rings in KrullsHeightTheorem applies to the stalk. Its maximal ideal has finite height by Krull's height theorem, and this height equals the local ring dimension. Apply ringKrullDim_lt_top.
